instruction: Write an ARO feature set that moves the report file to another folder.
output:
```aro
(MoveReport: File API) {
    Create the <source-file> with "./in/report.csv".
    Create the <dest-file> with "./archive/report.csv".
    Move the <moved: source-file> to the <destination: dest-file>.
    Return an <OK: status> for the <moved>.
}
```

instruction:
Fix this ARO — the Move syntax is wrong:
```aro
(MoveFile: File API) {
    Move the <file> from the <source: "./old/path/file.txt"> to the <destination: "./new/path/file.txt">.
    Return an <OK: status> for the <file>.
}
```
output:
`Move` has no `from` preposition (only `to`), and the source path goes in the result qualifier — not a separate `<source>` object. Create file handles for the source and destination, then move between them:

```aro
(MoveFile: File API) {
    Create the <source-file> with "./old/path/file.txt".
    Create the <dest-file> with "./new/path/file.txt".
    Move the <moved: source-file> to the <destination: dest-file>.
    Return an <OK: status> for the <moved>.
}
```
